chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who stood up for prayer and forgot to say the Takbir until he had commenced the prayer. He said, 'He must repeat it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one forgets the opening Takbir and starts praying?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that omitting the opening Takbir (Takbirat al-Ihtiram) due to forgetfulness invalidates the prayer, requiring a full repetition rather than a simple correction. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that the opening Takbir is a fundamental pillar (rukn) of the prayer, distinguishing it from minor omissions that may be rectified by prostration of forgetfulness (sujood al-sahw). The chain of transmission highlights the reliability of the Kufan school of hadith through Ubayd ibn Zurara, a prominent companion of the Imams.
